import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load datasets
df_train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
df_test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
df_sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Training data shape: {df_train.shape}")
print(f"Test data shape: {df_test.shape}")

# Identify columns
id_col = "id"
species_col = "species"
feature_cols = [c for c in df_train.columns if c not in [id_col, species_col]]
print(f"Number of features: {len(feature_cols)}")

# Prepare feature matrices
X_train_full = df_train[feature_cols].values
y_train_full = df_train[species_col].values
X_test = df_test[feature_cols].values
test_ids = df_test[id_col].values

# CRITICAL FIX: Fit LabelEncoder on ALL training labels BEFORE any splitting
# This prevents class distribution leakage and ensures consistent label mapping
label_encoder = LabelEncoder()
y_train_encoded_full = label_encoder.fit_transform(y_train_full)
classes = label_encoder.classes_
n_classes = len(classes)
print(f"Number of classes: {n_classes}")

# Create proper train/val split - model trains only on train portion
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_full,
    y_train_encoded_full,
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=y_train_encoded_full,
)
print(f"Train split: {X_train.shape[0]}, Val split: {X_val.shape[0]}")

# Train Random Forest on training split only with improved parameters
rf_clf = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=300,
    max_depth=25,
    min_samples_split=4,
    min_samples_leaf=2,
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
    class_weight="balanced",
)
rf_clf.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Validate on hold-out set
y_val_pred = rf_clf.predict_proba(X_val)
epsilon = 1e-15
y_val_pred = np.clip(y_val_pred, epsilon, 1 - epsilon)
val_loss = log_loss(y_val, y_val_pred, labels=classes)
print(f"Validation Multi-class Log Loss (hold-out): {val_loss:.6f}")

# Refit on full training data for better generalization (allowed post-validation)
rf_clf_full = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=300,
    max_depth=25,
    min_samples_split=4,
    min_samples_leaf=2,
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
    class_weight="balanced",
)
rf_clf_full.fit(X_train_full, y_train_encoded_full)

# Predict on test set
y_test_pred = rf_clf_full.predict_proba(X_test)
y_test_pred = np.clip(y_test_pred, epsilon, 1 - epsilon)

# Create submission in EXACT format matching sample_submission.csv
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_ids,
        **{col: y_test_pred[:, i] for i, col in enumerate(classes)},
    }
)

# Verify submission format
print(f"Submission shape: {submission.shape}")
print(f"Expected columns from sample: {len(df_sample_sub.columns)}")
print(f"Actual columns: {len(submission.columns)}")
print(f"Column names match: {list(submission.columns) == list(df_sample_sub.columns)}")

# Save submission
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(
    f"Submission file has {len(submission)} rows and {len(submission.columns)} columns"
)
